string date_text(int year, int month, int day)
    return "{year:04.}-{month:02.}-{day:02.}"
common_months := [31, 28, 31, 30, 31, 30, 31, 31, 30, 31, 30, 31]
    original := date_text(year, month, day)
    for: added < days
        leap := year % 400 == 0 or (year % 4 == 0 and year % 100 != 0)
        month_length := common_months[month - 1]
        if month == 2 and leap
            month_length = 29
        day += 1
        if day > month_length
            day = 1
            month += 1
            if month > 12
                month = 1
                year += 1
    println("{original} + {days} days = {date_text(year, month, day)}")
